desc: a hulking null-armoured warden walking AWAY from the viewer: the back of a broad squat humanoid in dark blue-grey plate with pale cyan rune glints on the pauldrons and back plate, a horned helm seen from BEHIND (the horns curving away from the camera, no faceplate, no visor, no eye glints), a huge greatsword carried on the back or in one hand, thick armoured legs
defect: the current north strip shows the FRONT of the helm (faceplate, visor band, eye glints, horns toward the camera)
desc_v2:
THE CHARACTER (reference 1 -- reproduce this exact figure, its design must not
change): a hulking warden seen from BEHIND in heavy blackened plate armour laced with thin
glowing CYAN cracks, huge layered pauldrons (as wide as in reference 1), a horned helm seen from
behind, a brown leather tabard hanging from the belt over the back of the thighs, thick armoured
legs and sabatons. HIS HANDS ARE EMPTY gauntleted fists swinging at his sides, exactly as in
reference 1: he carries NO weapon -- draw NO sword, blade, hilt, shield or anything slung across
the back or hanging from the belt. The rune emblem on his chest is on the FRONT ONLY; the back is
plain plate with the cyan cracks.
